shared_elements: upright monolithic pillar/figure with a distinct head or capital above a broad flat body
low-relief motifs carved on the broad face of the standing block
schematic, non-naturalistic rendering of a body without articulated limbs in the round
small repeated relief shapes/animal-or-creature forms distributed over the surface
curved/rounded relief element on the body (loop or disc-like form in B, arched relief in A)
justification: Both depict a tall, schematic anthropomorphic monolith with a differentiated head over a plain broad body, carrying shallow low-relief motifs spread across that body surface, which is a moderately specific shared conception. However the actual iconography differs: A shows quadruped/animal forms and a reticulated field in relief, while B shows discs, rings and crouching creature-like figures arranged symmetrically about a spine, with no motif in common beyond generic rounded shapes.
